en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> sent someone to Bishr Bin Utaradi Al-Tameemy regarding a speech which reached him<sup>asws</sup>. So the messenger of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> passed by him among the Clan of Asad and seized him. So Nuaym Bin Dajaja Al-Asady stood up to him and had him released.

So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> sent someone to him, so he came up with him, and he<sup>asws</sup> ordered for him to be whipped. So Nuaym said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the staying with you<sup>asws</sup> is a disgrace, and in separation from you<sup>asws</sup> is infidelity’.
So when he<sup>asws</sup> heard that from him, he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘O Nuaym! We<sup>asws</sup> have excused you,
for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [23:96] Repel evil by what is best.

As for your words that, ‘Staying with you<sup>asws</sup> is disgrace’, so it is an evil which you have attained; and as for your words, ‘In separation from you<sup>asws</sup> is infidelity’, so it is a good deed which you have attained. So this here (compensates) for this’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> ordered that he be released from it’.
